findings.measure: party organization under Election Code chapter171
findings.finding: County executive committee has county chair and precinct chairs; precinct chairs elected at general primary, with statutory appointment/vacancy procedures. A county unit is not a municipal government body.
findings.sourceTerms: Enacted law only, government edict; no editorial material copied.

findings.finding: Town committees are recognized; party rules govern membership and endorsement/election processes within statutory requirements. Do not impose a nationwide county unit.
findings.sourceTerms: Enacted law only, government edict; no editorial material copied.

findings.scope: Roster card labels are not a reconciled chamber composition. Do not map island status parties to a national party from name similarity.
findings.sourceTerms: Only party-name facts from official roster; no images, names, biographies or web prose copied. Full-site license not established.

gaps.finding: Official roster card text was not a reconciled full 27-seat return; raw label occurrence counts do not establish allocation. No membership names collected and no seats inferred.

gaps.scope: all56 local units, party registration/switching and presidential allocation
gaps.finding: Only TX/CT legal examples verified. No national switching rate or general minor-party threshold can substitute for jurisdiction law/party-cycle rules.

interpretation: Aggregate observations calibrate totals; they do not choose an individual actor outcome. Legal rules apply only to the stated jurisdiction and vintage. Missing coverage is not legal permission. No excluded source or real-person name is included.
